label: Diagram 3.10
caption: Diagram 3.10 Sanitary fittings associated clear access zones and permitted encroachment of basins – wheelchair adaptable
description: This is a set of plans with a Key and a green title bar at the bottom reading "Diagram 3.10 Sanitary fittings associated clear access zones and permitted encroachment of basins – wheelchair adaptable". The main plan (top left) shows a bathroom corner with a shaded square access zone labelled a, a WC symbol and basin symbol d on the bottom wall, and basin symbols b (left) and c (top). Dimensions include 350mm, 750mm and 1000mm across the top, 1100mm and 750mm down the left, 200mm Max in three places, and 450-500mm at the foot; dashed lines in the plan mark the maximum encroachment of the basins, and e and f are dimension callouts at the bottom right (the 200mm and 300mm values given in the Key). The Key defines a to f, including maximum encroachment of 200mm for a hand rinse basin and 300mm for a wash hand basin. A top-right plan shows a 700mm by 1100mm shaded access zone in front of a round basin (drawn above the basin symbol); a bottom-left plan shows a 700mm wide rectangular basin with an adjacent 1100mm shaded access zone to its left. The bottom-right plan shows a level access shower with a 1500mm diameter clear turning circle (R750mm), a 500mm dimension, and text that this may overlap fully with the shower. Four numbered notes follow.
